title: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword
shortDescription: Chronological origin of the Master Sword utilizing 1:1 Wii MotionPlus swordplay in the sky kingdom of Skyloft.
historicalSignificance: Introduced the stamina gauge and dungeon-like surface regions that laid architectural foundations for Breath of the Wild.
